How it works

KaribuFans connects you to the business. You pay them directly, not us.

1

Choose

Browse stays, food spots, places to watch the game, nightlife and more, area by area.

2

Book directly

Book on the business's own website, or get directions and go. Once a business joins, you can message it on WhatsApp from its listing.

3

Get there

Uber opens with your destination filled in. For Bolt, open the app and type the place.

For Nairobi businesses

Put your business in front of new customers.

No listing fee. You pay a commission only on customers we send you.
